title: Compare light and matter
statement:
At fixed wavelength, which relation gives an electromagnetic photon’s energy in vacuum?

[_]{a}

explanations: The relation combines c=λν with E=hν.
That is not Planck’s energy relation.
This gives frequency without converting to energy.

hints: Connect wavelength to frequency using c.
Planck’s relation multiplies frequency by h.
solution: Connect wavelength to frequency using c. Planck’s relation multiplies frequency by h. Substitute c/λ. The relation combines c=λν with E=hν.
